caption: The drawing depicts a teapot with a long, straight spout on the left and a large, curved handle on the right that is colored solid black and styled to resemble an animal head, most likely a bird or a horse, with a small circular eye near where it attaches to the teapot. The body of the teapot is light in color, outlined in black, and has a rounded shape with a defined base and a lid topped with a knob. The outline lines are thin and uniform, creating a clean, minimalistic appearance. The teapot is centrally placed on an off-white or beige background, with no additional objects in the composition. There is a small oval containing the letters "BW" near the left side of the teapot's base, and a signature, "Lawrence Flynn," in the bottom right corner of the image.
title: Silver Teapot
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
